description.zh: 在这台设备上运行命令。

description.en: Run a command on the device and return its output. Read-only commands such as ls, cat or df run immediately when they only touch the shared folders; anything that changes the system, or reads a protected location, waits for the owner's approval.
description.zh: 在设备上运行一条命令并返回输出。只读命令（ls、cat、df 等）在只访问共享文件夹时直接执行；会改动系统或读取受保护位置（密钥、凭据）的命令需要主人批准。

command.description: The command line, e.g. "ls -la /tmp" (read-only commands without shell operators run immediately)
